data.desc: Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp. (NASDAQ: CCEC) is an international shipping company and one of the world's leading platforms for gas carriage solutions with a focus on the energy transition. CCEC's fleet includes 15 high-specification vessels in operation, comprised of 12 latest-generation LNG carriers and three legacy Neo-Panamax container vessels, one of which CCEC has agreed to sell. In addition, the Company has 16 new-buildings under construction, including six LNG carriers, six dual-fuel medium gas carriers, and four handy-size LCO/multi-gas carriers, scheduled for delivery between the first quarter of 2026 and the third quarter of 2027.
